description: This Java test class verifies the immutability and error code correctness of the PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException class. It uses JUnit for testing and interacts with JSON objects and custom exceptions related to policies in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PolicyEntryNotAccessibleExceptionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException, testing immutability and error code logic.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException class is immutable.

methods.name: checkPolicyErrorCodeWorks
methods.description: Validates that the JSON correctly parses into the expected exception with the correct error code and message.
